findings.claim: The replacement invalidation mechanism can still detach mutation execution from changed inputs. doc_diff() treats git diff base...head rc=0 as measured, but Git returns rc=0 and chooses one merge base on criss-cross history. A real scratch graph produced an empty doc_diff while a clean git merge-tree changed ci_dang_ky_test.py. Section 2c therefore mandates skip, contradicting 2d and the changed-input guarantee. The existing outer CI classifier detects this ambiguity and selects day_du, but that does not force the new inner K5 selector. The specified two-commit tests cannot expose this history-dependent failure.
